LanguageData.HD_Sledgehammer_Breach_Desc: Break an ordinary door belonging to another faction so it stays open until repaired, or destroy a wall with repeated strikes. Security, vault, blast and reinforced doors cannot be breached with this tool.
LanguageData.HD_Sledgehammer_Breach_Unavailable: The sledgehammer cannot be used right now.
LanguageData.HD_Sledgehammer_Breach_InvalidTarget: Select an ordinary door of another faction that cannot be opened, or a wall.
LanguageData.HD_Sledgehammer_Breach_CannotReserve: The selected structure is already reserved.
